title: 'feat(dataZoom): new option handleLabel.show'
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Slider dataZoom handles can show useful value text while users interact, but some applications want those handle labels visible even outside active dragging or emphasis states. At the moment authors cannot explicitly control that visibility.


  ## Desired outcome

  Introduce `handleLabel.show` for slider dataZoom so teams can decide whether the handle labels are visible in the normal state, while `emphasis.handleLabel.show` continues to control the emphasized or dragging state separately.


  ## Acceptance signals

  Setting `handleLabel.show` toggles normal-state handle-label visibility, `emphasis.handleLabel.show` governs the emphasized state, and existing slider behavior is preserved when the new option is left unset.'
title: 'feat(geo): add `totalZoom` parameter for the `georoam` event'
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Applications that react to map zooming often need the cumulative zoom level, not just the latest roam gesture, in order to coordinate labels, overlays, or linked views. Today a `georoam` listener can detect that roaming happened but cannot directly read the total scale after repeated zoom operations.


  ## Desired outcome

  Expose the accumulated zoom ratio on the `georoam` event as `totalZoom` so integrators can base follow-up UI logic on the map’s current effective zoom level instead of reconstructing it themselves.


  ## Acceptance signals

  A `georoam` handler receives `totalZoom` after zoom interactions, the value tracks cumulative zoom state across successive operations, and existing roam event behavior continues to work for listeners that do not use the new field.'
title: 'feat(map): support `regions[].silent` and update map data in tests'
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Map authors sometimes need a region to remain visible but non-interactive, for example when a background territory should not respond to hover, selection, or tooltip behavior. ECharts already supports top-level `silent` behavior, but there is no reliable per-region contract for map and geo regions, so authors cannot selectively disable interaction on individual areas.

  ## Desired outcome

  Region configuration should support `silent` at the per-region level through `regions[].silent`, and that setting should be honored for both geo-based maps and `series.map` rendering. A region marked silent should keep its visual appearance while opting out of event handling and interactive affordances, without forcing the entire map to become non-interactive.

  ## Acceptance signals

  Authors can declare `silent` on individual entries in `regions`, and the targeted region becomes non-interactive while neighboring regions continue to respond normally. The contract applies consistently to rendered GeoJSON regions and SVG-backed regions, and map data refreshes should preserve the updated region behavior instead of losing it when the source map data changes.

  '
